arguments.name: dwellingCode
arguments.description: the dwelling type code to search for (e.g., "000006")

raw.name: dwellingCode
raw.description: the dwelling type code to search for (e.g., "000006")

arguments.name: dwellingName
arguments.description: The dwelling type name to search for (e.g., "Annex / Portion", "Apartment"). Either dwellingCode or dwellingType must be provided.

raw.name: dwellingName
raw.description: The dwelling type name to search for (e.g., "Annex / Portion", "Apartment"). Either dwellingCode or dwellingType must be provided.

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing dwelling types, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All (ctl00$body$ContentSearch$butAll) and returns every grid row.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing dwelling types, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All (ctl00$body$ContentSearch$butAll) and returns every grid row.

arguments.name: pageNumber
arguments.description: Specific page number to fetch (used when not auto-fetching all pages). Default "1".

raw.name: pageNumber
raw.description: Specific page number to fetch (used when not auto-fetching all pages). Default "1".

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Number of rows requested per page. Server may cap it. Default "100".

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description: Number of rows requested per page. Server may cap it. Default "100".

arguments.name: autoFetchAllPages
arguments.description: If "true", tool loops through all pages. Defaults to true when returnAll is used.

raw.name: autoFetchAllPages
raw.description: If "true", tool loops through all pages. Defaults to true when returnAll is used.

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety limit to avoid infinite loops. Default "50".

raw.name: maxPages
raw.description: Safety limit to avoid infinite loops. Default "50".
